prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1423; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was operating a sedan southbound and attempting a left turn at an intersection in League City, Texas, when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by a pickup truck traveling northbound, operated by Driver 2. Driver 1 reported pain in the right knee after the collision and was transported for evaluation. The injury reported is consistent with the type and force of this impact, given how the sedan's left side was driven into and the way the occupant compartment was affected. Damage visible on the sedan matches the described sequence of events, and no prior damage to the vehicle was known to either party or noted at the scene. Responding officers confirmed that Driver 1 was inside the vehicle at the time of the crash, and the Passenger seated in the front right position was also present and was checked at the scene. Scene photographs confirm several details reported by both drivers, including final rest positions and debris location. No independent witnesses were located at the scene or identified afterward. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the sedan, which was verified during the investigation.
